paper_id: He et al. - 2017 - Pervasive Floorplan Generation Based on Only Inertial Sensing Feasibility, Design, and Implementati
title: Pervasive Floorplan Generation Based on Only Inertial Sensing: Feasibility, Design, and Implementation
motivation: Floorplans are in great demand but unavailable due to commercial/security reasons; existing approaches rely on infrastructural references that may be unavailable to users.
problem_framing: How to generate indoor floorplans using only low-quality inertial sensing from crowdsourced smartphones, coping with noise, ambiguity, and behavior diversity.
key_insight: People's behavior offers meaningful clues—turns at corners and stationary stops at featured locations (water dispensers) enable labeling pathlets for progressive bundling into floorplans.
method_signature: Nail (featured location) + TriNail (triangle of three Nails) as minimal stable structure for robust pathlet bundling under noisy conditions.
evaluation_criteria: Hallway shape precision/recall/F-measure and room size error, compared against CrowdInside and Jigsaw baselines.
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Two analogous sub-structures when not covered by any pathlet cannot be filtered, leading to small fraction of pathlets bundled to wrong places, but generally does not change floorplan shape.
evidence_for_taste: feature labels corresponding to a pathlet

thinking_moves: 从行为模式提取位置特征: 利用人走路在拐角转弯、在饮水机停留的规律性行为作为定位线索
定义最小稳定单元解决噪声问题: 三个点构成三角形是平面结构的最小要求,TriNail能消除矛盾干扰
容错近似而非精确匹配: 用重叠面积比阈值判断三角相似性,容忍惯性传感的定位误差
迭代优先选择过滤类似子结构: 通过出现频率和禁用原则逐步消除歧义,而非一次性全局解决
